newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American finalizes merger, splits.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American finalizes merger, splits.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Wednesday it has signed the final merger agreement to acquire California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows Operating Co. This agreement follows the terms and conditions of the previously announced binding agreement, approved unanimously by the directors of Patriot American, California Jockey Club and Bay Meadows and announced on October 31. Patriot said that a shareholder meeting to approve the transaction will be held in May.

The company also announced a record date of March 7, 1997 for its two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend. The brokers' cutoff date has been set at March 14, with an anticipated date for mailing certificates of March 18.
Company officials said the exchange ratio for the merger will be adjusted as a result of the split.
